description: Unauthorized Access to HPC Compute Resources Attackers could exploit overly permissive security group rules (e.g., albSg allows HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere) or leverage compromised credentials to access compute resources. An attacker compromises the ALB or head nodes through exposed management interfaces, then pivots to gain access to compute nodes containing sensitive simulation data.
references: recommendation: Implement stricter network access controls and segmentation

description: Data Exfiltration from Storage Systems Data could be exposed through misconfigured bucket policies, overly permissive IAM roles, or unencrypted data transfers. An attacker with access to the compute nodes could exfiltrate sensitive data from S3 buckets or FSx shares, potentially exposing critical power grid information.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
mitreATT&CK: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account
recommendation: Implement comprehensive data access monitoring

description: Insufficient Disaster Recovery and Rollback Capabilities Current infrastructure lacks automated rollback mechanisms and comprehensive backup strategies for all components. A ransomware attack or system failure could result in extended downtime due to insufficient recovery mechanisms.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1486 - Data Encrypted for Impact
recommendation: Implement comprehensive backup and recovery strategy

description: Analytics Pipeline Data Manipulation Attackers could manipulate ETL jobs, modify data in transit, or compromise ML models to produce incorrect analysis results. An attacker modifies Glue ETL jobs or tampers with data in S3 to produce incorrect power grid simulation analysis, leading to poor operational decisions.
references: owaspTop10: A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures
